 "command": "cat > programs/task-1bfebf10.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # The 3-color vertical pattern on the right edge is the stamp; replicate it
    # vertically, centered on every gray marker.
    motif=None
    for x in (w-1,0):
        vals=[(y,grid[y][x]) for y in range(h) if grid[y][x] not in (1,6)]
        if len(vals)>=2 and all(vals[i+1][0]==vals[i][0]+1 for i in range(len(vals)-1)):
            motif=[v for _,v in vals]
            break
    if motif is None:
        return out
    mid=len(motif)//2
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if grid[y][x]==6:
                for i,c in enumerate(motif):
                    yy=y+i-mid
                    if 0<=yy<h:
                        out[yy][x]=c
    return out
PY
